description: Erection of two storey rear extension to retained commercial unit (Use Class E); two storey rear infill extension and change of use of first and second floors from ancillary office space (Use Class E) to residential (Use Class C3) to provide six self-contained residential units (4x2 bed and 2x1 bed); two storey upward extension provide three self-contained residential units (1x1 bed, 1x2 bed and 1x3 bed) (nine dwellings total) with associated refuse storage, cycle parking and landscaping.
